# prime-password

prime-rs: Password component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/password) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-password) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/password.md)

Password — port of `p-password` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Root `span.p-password` with an `InputText` field, optional clear and show-password icons and a hint panel
`div.p-password-overlay` with a strength meter. The value is an optional two-way `value: RwSignal<String>`.

Strength is computed by `strength` by default (same as the default PrimeNG regular expressions); custom rules
are set by the `strength` property.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_password::Password;

let html = view! { <Password toggle_mask=true placeholder="Password" /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-password-input") && html.contains(r#"type="password""#) && html.contains("p-password-unmask-icon"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-password = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["password"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
